confirmed.statement: Both studies supplied generative-AI material: ERNIE Bot is identified as Baidu's large language model, and the scripted partner delivered ideas from a pool of 50 ideas generated by ERNIE Bot in advance. The form correctly codes ideas_supplied.

confirmed.statement: In S1, the LLM partner supplied five randomly selected pool ideas per response, with 100 seconds between responses and six responses during the 10-minute task; this supports the form's total of 30 ideas.

confirmed.statement: S1 used an active human-partner comparison: the LLM was excluded, and the same research assistant pasted human-written pool ideas, could modify or expand them, and responded to participants. The human pool contained 50 selected ideas originating from eight people.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 3, Study materials, final paragraph, continuing at the top of PDF p. 4.

confirmed.statement: In both studies, participants read their assigned partner's ideas while generating their own ideas for 10 minutes. The simple task concerned creative uses for a tire; the complex task concerned innovative features and solutions for VR glasses. Assignment therefore changed assistance for participants' own work, rather than only whose output was evaluated.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 4, Experiment 1, Participants and procedures, second paragraph; PDF p. 5, Experiment 2, Participants and procedures, second paragraph; PDF p. 5, Measurements in each experiment describes scoring participants' ideas.

confirmed.statement: S2 compared two configurations of AI assistance: batch-responsive supplied ten ideas every 200 seconds over three responses, and constrained-responsive supplied two ideas every 40 seconds over fifteen responses. Both supplied 30 ideas in total, matching the form's arms and ai_tool fields.
confirmed.locator: PDF p. 3, Study materials, first paragraph, Experiment 2 configuration sentences; PDF p. 5, Experiment 2, Participants and procedures, second paragraph maps the response quantities to the condition names.

confirmed.statement: Neither study used a within-person comparison: each participant was assigned to one between-participants condition, so randomized condition order is not applicable.

confirmed.statement: The described AI assistance used fixed scripts and response schedules.
